name: Creamy Tomato Basil Soup in Sourdough Bread Bowl
whyItWorks: Tomato acidity combined with heavy cream, garlic, and basil can cause heartburn and gastric reflux, while the concentrated dairy triggers lactose sensitivity in prone guts.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Acid & Dairy Warning: Better suited for remission. Dip sourdough bread lightly into the soup rather than drinking the whole bowl.
